command: python3 tools/validate.py && python3 -O -m unittest discover -s tests -v
dependencies: Python standard library only; no SDK or HTTP implementation
blocked: durable allocation/substep retention and crash/restart protocol
not_run: real provider authentication and response qualification
limitations: Injected callbacks and transport are not authenticated authority or provider identity.
Readback is sequential, not an atomic Slack snapshot or current authority guarantee.
Result classifications are unqualified wire facts, never journal/Core receipts.
Explicit upload calls can be repeated by callers; no durable send fence or automatic retries exist.
Transport must enforce byte/time/redirect bounds before buffering; no concrete HTTP client is provided.
Strict file-share subset rejects nonempty blocks/structured attachments and incomplete/multiple shares.
Source protocols require separately retained operation-to-Slack-file binding before production integration.
